description: Runtime StrokeReference packs (one JSON per character) derived from KanjiVG, for stroke-order animation and tracing.

derivedLicense.reason: The resampled polylines are an adaptation of KanjiVG, so share-alike propagates to the generated files in public/content/strokes/.
derivedLicense.requiredAttribution: Stroke data from KanjiVG (http://kanjivg.tagaini.net), Copyright (C) 2009-2025 Ulrich Apel, CC BY-SA 3.0.

sources.name: KanjiVG
sources.role: stroke paths and stroke order (redistributed in adapted form)
sources.redistribution: Permitted. Requires (1) attribution stating use of KanjiVG in our own copyright header with a link to the KanjiVG website, and (2) share-alike on derived works.
sources.notes: Archive lays files out as kanji/XXXXX.svg, not svg/XXXXX.svg. Contains no variant (<hex>-<name>.svg) files.

sources.name: KANJIDIC2
sources.role: verification only — stroke counts cross-checked; no content redistributed
sources.copyright: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group
sources.redistribution: Not redistributed by this dataset; used at build time to verify stroke counts.

sources.name: data/kanji-top1000.json
sources.role: input — defines which kanji get stroke references
sources.license: see that file's own provenance record
sources.redistribution: in-repo input, not an upstream source of this dataset

unsourced: Accepted stroke-order variants. orderVariants is [] for every character: KanjiVG ships no machine-readable alternative-order data and none was invented.
Kana stroke counts have no machine-readable authority in our sources. They are the KanjiVG path count, hand-spot-checked (ne=2, tsu=3) against standard kana stroke-order charts.
reproduce: npm run content:fetch     # KanjiVG + KANJIDIC2 into data/sources/, recorded in data/sources/SOURCES.lock.json

independentReimplementationCrossCheck.method: Separately written Python parser, t-uniform De Casteljau at 4000 steps/segment, compared over all 10211 strokes. One-off, not committed.

coarselySampledStrokes.threshold: 24-point polyline shorter than 95% of true arc length

knownUpstreamDisagreement.statement: KanjiVG and KANJIDIC2 stroke counts agree on 98.3% of the 6416 kanji both cover (6307 agree, 109 disagree), usually because KanjiVG draws a different glyph form. None of the 109 is in KANJIDIC2's top 1000 by frequency, and none is in the taught set.

reproduceNotes: No unzip/gunzip needed: the build reads kanjivg-*-main.zip directly (node:zlib) and accepts kanjidic2.xml or kanjidic2.xml.gz. An already-extracted directory is used if present; zip and directory builds were verified byte-identical. Output is deterministic across runs.
dependencies: none — node builtins only (crypto, fs, path, url, zlib)
consumedBy: scripts/assets/build-fonts.mjs (uses the <hex>.json filenames to decide font subset coverage)
